page: Amazon Web Services i7i.4xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with a dedicated Intel Xeon 8559C processor operating at 3.2 GHz, delivering 8 physical cores and 16 vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of high-speed 6 GHz DDR5 memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled with a 3750 GB NVMe SSD, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 9 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in specific workloads. The single-core Geekbench score of 2308.0 and the text processing score of 2840.0 both rank in the top tier (top 10%). Additionally, the instance achieves top-tier performance in LLM inference text generation using a small 135M model, reaching 395.0 tokens per second. Memory write bandwidth for large blocks is strong at 91.67 GB/sec, and single-threaded gzip compression performs at 34.75 GB/sec, placing both in the top 25%. Other metrics, such as multi-core CPU performance, Redis operations, and database operations, fall within the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of a large 3750 GB local NVMe SSD alongside 128.0 GB of DDR5 memory provides high resource density for storage-intensive applications without requiring external storage attachments. The presence of advanced CPU instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), enhances its capability for localized machine learning and cryptographic operations. This server is optimized for high-throughput databases, localized data processing, text processing, and small-scale LLM inference workloads.
